text.offer: Are you truly ready to learn the magic of songs of Jala? If so you must prove your devotion to the arts. I would like you to try out your voice. Go to the merchant of Barloque and sing a song. Any song you wish. Then come back to me and let me know how it went.
text.complete: Oh well, we shall work on that. Now open your mind to the ways of Jala; I shall train your voice, if you are willing.

steps.objective: Sing a song for the merchant of Barloque

steps.brief: By my troth, that is awful. Did Parrin send thee? Tell him to train thy voice.
steps.objective: Tell Parrin, honestly, how it went
